explication: Skills for Copilot Studio is an editor/CLI plugin for authoring, synchronizing, testing, and troubleshooting standard Copilot Studio agents as YAML. Its main user workflow is to clone or pull agent files, author changes, validate or push them, then test a published agent and review results. The graph preserves the four documented sub-agents and the major authoring, management, test, and guidance capabilities. Script relationships use the shown source excerpts and SOURCE INDEX; unsampled skill internals are represented by their exact directories.
